integrationDefectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Narrow reviewed provider-NA unavailable state, not blanket token acceptance or blank/zero coercion.

integrationDefectsFoundAndFixed.defect: Exact-day-only Profit matching made all471113 then-streamed netProfit values null.
